items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Buildings-only policy: theft/removal by third parties is not an insured peril (2.1, 3.1.4); personal effects and property in a conveyance away from the insured location are not insured (4.3(d),(e),(f)). t = 0.
There is no insured event, and conveyance and journey costs are expressly excluded (5.2.5, 7.1.8(d)). t = 0.
